simple.meaning: יִשְׁבָּק (Yishbâq) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jishbak , a son of Abraham.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִשְׁבָּק (H3435) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:2, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִשְׁבָּק (H3435) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יִשְׁבָּק (H3435) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יִשְׁבָּק (Yishbâq) / H3435 is traced through Genesis 25:2, 1 Chronicles 1:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
